name: Suspicious Spiced Fried Chicken
desc: Fried chicken wrapped in a crispy green skin. But before you can even taste the fried chicken, the preponderance of spices already has you choking up... You planned to study after this filling meal, but it seems a glass of water is in order first...

value.text: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 510 HP every 5s for 30s.
